liam_c: FYI a customer upgraded to the latest python client and started seeing a silent token-refresh loop that triggers extra POSTs — billing spike. repro attached.

marta_support: Ugh. Which client version? any quick repro?

liam_c: They moved from 1.46 -> 1.47. Repro steps I used:
```\n# repro.py\nfrom redwood import RedwoodClient\n\nc = RedwoodClient(api_key=\"XXX\")\nfor i in range(3):\n    resp = c.generate(model=\"rwd-light/1.0\", prompt=\"test\")\n    print(i, resp.status_code)\n```\nThen I did: `pip install redwood-sdk==1.47` and ran `python repro.py` against a staging key.

liam_c: What I saw in logs: first request -> 401, SDK tries refresh, concurrently issues another POST without idempotency header, both succeed -> customer charged twice. snippet:
```\n[2026-02-12T14:12:01Z] req=abc1234 POST /v1/generate 401 token-expired\n[2026-02-12T14:12:01Z] token-refresh start\n[2026-02-12T14:12:01Z] retry wrapper issuing retry POST /v1/generate req=abc1234-1 (no idempotency header)\n[2026-02-12T14:12:02Z] token-refresh success, original request retried -> POST /v1/generate req=abc1234-2\n```

sasha_g: Can you paste the exact traceback or error from the client? Also I've opened an internal escalation.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-3246 (severity: high) — added to #incidents and assigned to eng-runtime.

liam_c: No long python traceback; more a behavioral/regression. Console output just printed 200 twice. Customer provided billing spike screenshot.

eng_oncall: This feels like a race between the new retry behavior and token refresh. We changed the refresh handshake in 1.47 to be optimistic, but looks like we don't suppress retry when a refresh is inflight. Quick mitigation: pin to 1.46 or set env var to disable auto retries.

eng_oncall: Workaround commands I asked customer to run:
```\npip install \"redwood-sdk<1.47\"  # pin back to 1.46\n# OR\nexport REDWOOD_DISABLE_AUTO_RETRY=1\n# Also: add an Idempotency-Key header when issuing potentially billable POSTs\nheaders = {\"Idempotency-Key\": uuid4().hex}\n```

marta_support: I told the customer to pin to 1.46 and we issued a temporary credit for the duplicate token. They confirmed fewer duplicates but still one incident of double-charge (they're unhappy).

sasha_g: Created internal ticket INF-789 with logs and repro instructions, assigned to eng-runtime/serving. Please add the exact req ids if you get them.

eng_oncall: Adding notes to INF-789: likely fix paths — 1) ensure retry wrapper checks token-refresh-inflight flag 2) require idempotency for retries of POSTs 3) add opt-in telemetry for refresh/retry decision points.

liam_c: Customer provided req id abc1234 and a couple more, I uploaded them to the ticket and cc'd billing for refunds. :pray:

marta_support: Keeping customer updated; will request rollback guidance if eng requests it.

sasha_g: If eng wants a short-term release candidate, we can cut 1.47.1 with retry suppression; please include a minimal unit test reproducer.

liam_c: I'll attach the repro.py and the log snippets to INF-789. Thanks everyone.
